children.text: Everything after the core: owns the global state object, the DOM, and every interaction. Ten feature blocks form one mutually dependent group because they call each other through render. render calls applySelection, placeStrip, applyTalk, commentCounts, renderMsgTable, applyCam and edit (from + buttons); edit and the source sheet call setSource, which calls render; applyCam calls placeStrip; the selection bar calls askDelete, openComposer, openMessages and edit; the message table calls goTo, and goTo calls render, centerOn, select and closeSheetsOnPhone.

Pointer handling on the canvas. Tracks active pointers to pan with one finger or pinch-zoom with two, retaking a snapshot whenever the finger count changes. A move of 5px or more turns a press into a pan and suppresses the click. Click delegation, in order: comment bubble, open/close arrow, message-type owner link (no longer rendered anywhere), drawer go-to-card arrow, drawer row (toggle talk highlight), message chip or dot, drawer minimize button, drawer ear, behavior badge, connector line, then block selection; Cmd or Ctrl opens a comment. Double-click toggles both drawers. Hovering a chip or badge with a mouse shows its definition after 280ms. Also starts handle drags and blocks Safari's page-zoom gesture events.

  :type "App"

  ; ---------- Data that crosses the system ----------
  (message SourceText
    (sketch "An sbtel source string. The single source of truth: every canvas edit produces a new SourceText, which is re-parsed and redrawn."))
  (message Tokens
    (sketch "Flat list of parens, strings and symbols, each with start and end offsets into the source."))
  (message SExpr
    (sketch "Nested lists of tokens, each list carrying its start and end offsets so edits can splice the original text."))
  (message Model
    (sketch "Parsed spec: root block, maps of blocks, behaviors and message types by id, warnings, the source, and a node(id) lookup that understands the β: and μ: prefixes. Block nodes carry derived fields: levels (explicit and implicit runs of units), ownPorts, impl, behaviorDecls, messageDecls, sketch, parent."))
  (message LayoutOptions
    (sketch "Wrap rule (keep groups or break anywhere), wrapped-line rule (same group, previous in chain, nearest above), open-block width (fit or fill), whether child ports count, canvas width, the set of open blocks, the map of open drawers, and an unused details set."))
  (message Geometry
    (sketch "Layout result: positioned blocks (cards and frames, with metrics), adjacency connectors (each with a cut action), level dividers, level gutters, plus buttons with their edit actions, per-level item boxes for checking, a loc map from block id to its level, unit and index, the overall size, and the layout check results."))
  (message CheckResults
    (sketch "List of checks, each a key, a human label and a list of failures. Empty failures means the check passes."))
  (message MessageRows
    (sketch "One row per declared message type: name, declaring block, sketch, refines, the ports that use it and the types that refine it."))
  (message EditAction (sketch "One of the edits below; each refines it."))
  (message SplitGroup (refines EditAction) (sketch "Level, unit index and position to cut an adjacent group in two."))
  (message ConnectBlocks (refines EditAction) (sketch "Level, source unit and index, and target unit; the target's unit joins the source's group beside the source block."))
  (message AppendBlock (refines EditAction) (sketch "Level to append a new NewBlockN to."))
  (message InsertLevel (refines EditAction) (sketch "Block and position at which to insert a new level holding one new block."))
  (message AddDeclaration (refines EditAction) (sketch "Block and form (behavior or message) for a new NewBehaviorN or NewMessageN declaration."))
  (message DeleteNode (refines EditAction) (sketch "Node to remove, plus its level location when it is a block."))
  (message EditResult
    (sketch "New SourceText, plus the name of a block to flash and whether a linked block had to move."))
  (message TextRun (sketch "A string and a CSS font to measure."))
  (message Pixels (sketch "A width in pixels, or a number of wrapped lines."))
  (message UserInput (sketch "A DOM pointer, wheel, click, double-click or keyboard event."))
  (message CommentRecord
    (sketch "id, target key (block:, beh:, msg: or line:), text, status saved or sent, spec version stamp and time."))
  (message AgentPayload
    (sketch "Plain text: spec name and version, then each comment with its target and that target's current source."))
  (message StoredValue (sketch "A JSON value kept in this browser's localStorage."))
